integrity: The general theorem is proved symbolically by combining a quantifier-free undirected reduct with an orientation-preserving reading of the endpoint-coordinate strategy for cycles. A finite exhaustive solver is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to single directed cycles of length at least three in the pure successor-relation language. Priority remains at residual risk because older unindexed notes or theses may contain the same sharp directed-cycle threshold.
title: Exact quantifier-rank threshold for finite directed cycles
